# fixtures/bundles — provenance (GENERATED by scripts/export-fixtures.ts; do not edit)

Public-interface bundles for the token indexer's verification tests (sub-plan 02-B5; spec 00024 US1 scenarios 3-6, FR-010-FR-013), all built from LSUNPI so one state fits every case: `LSUNPI.state.hex` (LSUNPI's serialized state after its plan in the Compact simulator — the same bytes as `fixtures/simulator/interfaces.json`). `cases.json` gives, per case, the URL it is published under, the event payload (`partsHex`), the bundle size and the expected outcome of an unattended verifier.

Regenerate: `node --import tsx scripts/export-fixtures.ts` — deterministic: two runs from the
same inputs give identical bytes (compare with the output hashes below). `test/fixtures.test.ts`
regenerates into a temporary directory and compares.

## Toolchain

| Piece | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Compact compiler (`compact compile +0.34.0`) | `0.34.0` (language `0.26.0`, runtime `0.19.0`) |
| `@midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime` (the simulator) | `0.19.0` |
| Public-interface tools | `tools/public-interface` — [B] PR #6 `1cf9477` + UC-3 + UC-2 (see its SOURCE.md) |
| Emitter secret of the corpus (a public TEST value, never a real secret) | 32 × 0x42; constructor argument `97ae9211dd0d4e532f6e494ecd75323cd2bbe1f5346df4d5c8446ddf34d11386` |

## Cases

| Case | URL | Bundle bytes | Expected (indexer) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `valid` | `http://bundles/fixtures/valid/index.json` | 184740 | verified |
| `tampered-file` | `http://bundles/fixtures/tampered-file/index.json` | 184786 | failed — src/generated/LSUNPI.compact: sha256 differs from index.json |
| `wrong-hash` | `http://bundles/fixtures/wrong-hash/index.json` | 184750 | failed — index.json hash differs from the event commitment; nothing but index.json requested |
| `over-size-cap` | `http://bundles/fixtures/over-size-cap/index.json` | 1233485 | unchecked — size cap: the bundle is larger than 1048576 bytes |
| `loopback-host` | `http://127.0.0.1/fixtures/loopback-host/index.json` | 184760 | unfetchable — private or loopback address (127.0.0.1) |
| `compiler-not-installed` | `http://bundles/fixtures/compiler-not-installed/index.json` | 184774 | verified — compiler 0.33.0 unavailable |

The over-size-cap case is built to exceed a **1048576-byte** bundle cap (`limits.maxBundleBytes` in cases.json); a verifier whose cap is larger verifies it like `valid` (it is a consistent bundle with one more listed file). The four PI bundles under `bundles/` are all far below that cap.
